name: Gauztuul the Terror

abilities.name: Freezing Breath
abilities.description: Gauztuul the Terror opens its maw and releases a wide cloud of freezing air, dealing continuous direct high frost damage. This attack has no indicator and covers most of the upper area, but a large yellow bubble (Barrier) appears and protects all targets inside it from "Freezing Breath".

abilities.name: Blistering Brimstone
abilities.description: Gauztuul the Terror spits out a large fiery boulder at your location which explodes on impact, indicated by a circular AoE, dealing moderate flame damage and leaving a lingering area dealing continuous low flame damage.

notes: Gauztuul the Terror bears some resemblance to Tzirzhalir, which can be encountered in Unhallowed Grave, and Mzrelnir in the Lucent Citadel.
related_quests: Support the Fellowship: Assist the Stirk Fellowship during the Battle for the Writhing Wall. (disabled)
summary: Gauztuul the Terror is a powerful creature resembling a giant Bone Colossus found at the end of the East Wing of the Writhing Fortress.
